name: Brocade Silk Kurta
title: Vastra Studio Men's Maroon Brocade Silk Blend Straight Kurta with Mandarin Collar - Festive and Wedding Wear
highlights: Woven brocade motifs in tonal gold thread across a deep maroon base
Mandarin collar with concealed placket and wooden buttons
Straight fit with side slits for easy movement while seated
Pairs with churidar, pyjama or ivory dhoti pants
description: A festive maroon brocade silk-blend kurta with subtle tonal woven motifs, a mandarin collar and a comfortable straight fit. The fabric holds its drape through long ceremonies, making it a dependable choice for weddings, sangeet evenings and Diwali gatherings.

name: Handloom Cotton Kurta
title: Mitti and Co. Men's Indigo Handloom Cotton Kurta with Block Print Detail - Casual Daywear
highlights: Breathable handwoven cotton that softens with every wash
Hand block printed geometric border along the placket
Lightweight enough for Indian summers and daytime events
Natural slubs in the weave are characteristic of handloom fabric
description: A breathable indigo handloom cotton kurta with hand block printed detailing along the placket. Light and unlined, it suits warm afternoons, casual office days and relaxed festive gatherings where comfort matters more than formality.
care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

name: Pastel Chikankari Kurta
title: Anaya Ethnics Men's Ivory Chikankari Embroidered Cotton Voile Kurta - Summer Festive Wear
highlights: Hand-done Lucknowi chikankari in self-tone white thread
Sheer cotton voile keeps the kurta cool in humid weather
Relaxed cut that does not cling in the heat
Recommended with a white cotton inner vest
description: An ivory cotton voile kurta with delicate hand-done Lucknowi chikankari across the yoke and cuffs. The sheer, airy weave and relaxed cut make it a refined pick for summer pujas, daytime functions and morning wedding ceremonies.
care: Hand wash separately in cold water

name: Classic Ivory Nehru Jacket
title: Rivaaz Men's Ivory Silk Blend Nehru Jacket with Band Collar - Layering Piece for Weddings
highlights: Sleeveless layering jacket worn over a kurta
Structured band collar holds its shape through the evening
Five-button front with welt pockets at the waist
Neutral ivory works over almost any kurta colour
description: An ivory silk-blend Nehru jacket cut to layer neatly over a kurta. The clean band collar and structured shoulders lift a plain kurta into wedding-appropriate dress, and the neutral shade coordinates with nearly any base colour.

name: Black Printed Nehru Jacket
title: Rivaaz Men's Black Printed Cotton Silk Nehru Jacket - Festive Layering Jacket
highlights: All-over geometric print in black, rust and antique gold
Cotton silk blend that breathes better than pure silk
Sleeveless jacket layer for kurtas and even plain shirts
Bold enough to carry an otherwise simple outfit
description: A black cotton-silk Nehru jacket carrying an all-over geometric print in rust, ivory and antique gold. It is the statement layer for sangeet nights and festive parties, adding pattern and colour over a plain kurta without extra bulk.

name: Royal Blue Wedding Sherwani
title: Zari Lane Men's Royal Blue Jacquard Silk Sherwani with Antique Gold Embroidery - Groom Wear
highlights: Antique gold zari embroidery across the chest, collar and cuffs
Fully lined with an inner canvas for a structured silhouette
Comes with a matching churidar and a coordinated stole
Built for grooms and close family at the main ceremony
description: A royal blue jacquard silk sherwani worked with antique gold zari across the chest and cuffs, fully lined for a structured groom silhouette. Supplied with a matching churidar and stole, it is dressed for the main wedding ceremony rather than a side event.

name: Champagne Gold Sherwani
title: Zari Lane Men's Champagne Gold Raw Silk Sherwani with Thread Embroidery - Reception Wear
highlights: Tonal thread embroidery that catches light without looking loud
Slim cut through the waist for a sharper reception silhouette
Raw silk with a natural texture and subtle sheen
Includes churidar; stole sold separately
description: A champagne gold raw silk sherwani with tonal thread embroidery that reads as texture rather than ornament. The slimmer cut suits receptions and engagements where the look should be formal but not as heavy as bridal-party wear.

name: Black Velvet Jodhpuri Suit
title: Vastra Studio Men's Black Velvet Jodhpuri Bandhgala Suit with Trousers - Formal Evening Wear
highlights: Plush velvet bandhgala with a closed high collar
Matching trousers included, unfinished hem for tailoring
Satin-lined interior with an inner chest pocket
Best suited to winter evenings and indoor receptions
description: A black velvet Jodhpuri bandhgala suit with a closed high collar and matching trousers. The deep pile fabric suits cool winter evenings and indoor receptions, offering an Indian formal alternative to a western dinner suit.

name: Linen Blend Pathani Suit
title: Mitti and Co. Men's Sand Linen Blend Pathani Kurta Set with Salwar - Casual Ethnic Wear
highlights: Two-piece set with matching straight-cut salwar
Linen blend keeps the set cool and structured
Four-button band collar with chest pocket
Sand is an easy alternative to plain white
description: A sand linen-blend Pathani suit with a band-collared kurta and matching straight salwar. Linen keeps the set crisp in heat, making it an easy daytime choice for Eid, family lunches and casual ethnic occasions.

name: Chestnut Velvet Waistcoat
title: Rivaaz Men's Chestnut Brown Velvet Ethnic Waistcoat with Front Buttons - Winter Layering
highlights: Rich chestnut velvet with a soft textured finish
Five-button front with a tailored V-neck opening
Shorter cut than a Nehru jacket, sits at the hip
Adds warmth over a kurta without a full jacket
description: A chestnut brown velvet waistcoat with a textured finish and a tailored V-neck front. Cut shorter than a Nehru jacket, it layers over a kurta for winter weddings and evening celebrations where a full jacket would feel heavy.

name: Mustard Bandhani Kurta Set
title: Vastra Studio Men's Mustard Bandhani Print Cotton Kurta with Pyjama - Festive Two Piece Set
highlights: Two-piece set with matching off-white cotton pyjama
Traditional bandhani tie-dye print in mustard and white
Three quarter sleeves suited to daytime functions
A natural fit for haldi and Navratri colour themes
description: A mustard cotton kurta carrying a traditional bandhani tie-dye print, paired with an off-white pyjama. The warm colour and daytime-friendly cotton make it a natural pick for haldi ceremonies, Navratri evenings and festive lunches.
care: Machine wash cold, do not bleach

name: Cream Silk Stole
title: Anaya Ethnics Men's Cream Silk Stole with Zari Border - Sherwani and Kurta Accessory
highlights: Two metre art silk stole with a woven zari border
Drapes over one shoulder with a sherwani or bandhgala
Cream tone coordinates with gold and ivory outfits
Light enough not to weigh down the shoulder line
description: A cream art silk stole finished with a woven zari border, cut long enough to drape cleanly over one shoulder. It completes a sherwani or bandhgala look and is the small accessory that separates a finished outfit from an unfinished one.

name: Ivory Cotton Churidar
title: Vastra Studio Men's Ivory Stretch Cotton Churidar Bottom - Kurta and Sherwani Pairing
highlights: Stretch cotton with the traditional gathered ankle
Drawstring waist with an inner elastic panel
Slim through the thigh and calf
Cut extra long so the ankle gathers correctly
description: An ivory stretch cotton churidar cut slim through the leg with the traditional gathered ankle. Deliberately made long so the fabric bunches correctly above the shoe, it is the standard bottom for sherwanis and longer kurtas.

name: White Cotton Dhoti Pants
title: Mitti and Co. Men's White Cotton Ready to Wear Dhoti Pants with Pockets - Temple and Festive Wear
highlights: Pre-stitched dhoti that needs no draping skill
Elasticated waist with a drawstring and side pockets
Pure cotton that stays cool during long ceremonies
Falls to the ankle with the traditional front pleat
description: Ready-to-wear white cotton dhoti pants with a pre-stitched front pleat, so no draping skill is needed. The elasticated waist and side pockets make them practical for long temple ceremonies and traditional family functions.

name: Black Thread Work Kurta
title: Rangrez Men's Black Cotton Silk Kurta with Tonal Thread Work - Evening Festive Wear
highlights: Black-on-black thread work along the yoke and placket
Slim cut that works under a jacket without bunching
Cotton silk blend with a soft matte sheen
Understated enough for evenings where guests should not outshine hosts
description: A black cotton-silk kurta with tonal black thread work across the yoke, cut slim so it layers under a jacket cleanly. Understated rather than ornate, it suits evening parties and sangeet nights where a guest should look sharp but not loud.

name: Sage Green Linen Kurta Set
title: Rangrez Men's Sage Green Linen Kurta with Pyjama - Summer Wedding Two Piece Set
highlights: Pure linen that stays cool through outdoor daytime events
Roll-tab sleeves that can be worn full or folded
Muted sage green photographs well in daylight
Matching pyjama included in the same linen
description: A sage green pure linen kurta with roll-tab sleeves and a matching pyjama. Linen breathes through outdoor daytime events, and the muted green photographs well in sunlight, which makes it a common pick for mehendi mornings and garden weddings.
care: Gentle machine wash, hot iron while damp

name: Crimson Anarkali Suit
title: Anaya Ethnics Women's Crimson Georgette Floor Length Anarkali Suit with Dupatta - Wedding Wear
highlights: Floor length flare with a fitted bodice and concealed zip
Zari and sequin embroidery across the yoke
Comes with a matching net dupatta and inner lining
Georgette falls softly and moves well while dancing
description: A crimson georgette Anarkali cut floor length with a fitted bodice and a wide flare that moves while dancing. Zari and sequin work covers the yoke, and a matching net dupatta completes it for weddings and reception evenings.

name: Rose Pink Bridal Lehenga
title: Zari Lane Women's Rose Pink Raw Silk Bridal Lehenga Choli with Embroidered Dupatta - Wedding
highlights: Three piece set: lehenga skirt, choli and dupatta
Hand-done zari and dori embroidery with sequin accents
Canvas-lined skirt with a can-can layer for volume
Choli has an adjustable back tie for fitting
description: A rose pink raw silk bridal lehenga with hand-done zari and dori embroidery, sold as a three piece set with choli and embroidered dupatta. The canvas-lined skirt holds a full bridal volume, and the choli ties at the back for fitting adjustments.

name: Navy Sequin Party Lehenga
title: Zari Lane Women's Navy Blue Sequin Party Lehenga Set with Crop Top - Sangeet and Cocktail
highlights: All-over sequin work that catches stage and party lighting
Lighter than a bridal lehenga, easier to dance in
Sleeveless crop top with a lined bodice
Dupatta included, can be draped or skipped
description: A navy blue net lehenga covered in fine sequin work, paired with a sleeveless crop top. Considerably lighter than bridal weight, it is built for sangeet nights and cocktail parties where you will actually be dancing.

name: Emerald Kanjivaram Silk Saree
title: Anaya Ethnics Women's Emerald Green Kanjivaram Silk Saree with Gold Zari Border and Blouse Piece
highlights: Pure Kanjivaram silk woven with a contrast gold zari border
Traditional temple motifs along the pallu
6.3 metres including an unstitched blouse piece
Silk mark certified handloom weave
description: An emerald green Kanjivaram silk saree woven with a contrast gold zari border and traditional temple motifs on the pallu. Supplied at 6.3 metres with an unstitched blouse piece, it carries the weight and fall expected of a wedding-grade silk.
care: Dry clean only, store wrapped in muslin

name: Beige Linen Saree
title: Mitti and Co. Women's Beige Handwoven Linen Saree with Contrast Border - Office and Daywear
highlights: Handwoven linen that holds a crisp pleat all day
Rust contrast border against a natural beige body
Light enough for daily wear in warm weather
Comes with an unstitched blouse piece
description: A beige handwoven linen saree with a rust contrast border, light enough to wear through a working day in warm weather. Linen holds a crisp pleat far better than cotton, which is why it suits office wear and daytime events.
care: Dry clean for first wash, then hand wash

name: Black Georgette Sequin Saree
title: Anaya Ethnics Women's Black Georgette Saree with Sequin Work and Stitched Blouse - Party Wear
highlights: Scattered sequin work that builds towards the pallu
Ready-to-wear stitched blouse included in size M
Georgette drapes close to the body without stiffness
Evening weight, not suitable for daytime formality
description: A black georgette saree with sequin work scattered across the body and gathering towards the pallu. It comes with a stitched blouse and drapes close to the body, aimed at cocktail parties and evening receptions rather than daytime events.

name: White Chikankari Kurti
title: Rangrez Women's White Cotton Chikankari Straight Kurti with Side Slits - Summer Casual Wear
highlights: Lucknowi chikankari in white-on-white thread
Straight cut with side slits for comfort over trousers
Pure cotton, unlined and breathable
Works over jeans, palazzos or churidars
description: A white cotton kurti with white-on-white Lucknowi chikankari, cut straight with side slits. Unlined and breathable, it moves easily between office days, casual outings and summer afternoons, and pairs with jeans as readily as with palazzos.
care: Hand wash cold, dry in shade

name: Mustard Printed A-Line Kurti
title: Rangrez Women's Mustard Floral Print Rayon A-Line Kurti with Pockets - Everyday Wear
highlights: A-line flare from the bust with functional side pockets
Soft rayon that does not need ironing after every wash
Small-scale floral print in mustard and off-white
Our highest rated everyday kurti by review volume
description: A mustard rayon kurti with a small floral print, cut A-line from the bust with functional side pockets. Rayon keeps it soft and low maintenance, which is why this is the everyday workhorse of the collection rather than an occasion piece.

name: Peach Palazzo Suit Set
title: Vastra Studio Women's Peach Embroidered Cotton Kurta with Palazzo and Dupatta - Three Piece Set
highlights: Three piece set: kurta, wide-leg palazzo and dupatta
Tonal thread embroidery around the neckline
Cotton throughout, comfortable for long daytime wear
Elasticated palazzo waist with a drawstring
description: A peach cotton three piece set with tonal thread embroidery at the neckline, matching wide-leg palazzos and a coordinating dupatta. Cotton throughout keeps it comfortable through long daytime functions where heavier fabrics become tiring.

name: Peacock Blue Sharara Set
title: Anaya Ethnics Women's Peacock Blue Georgette Sharara Set with Short Kurta and Dupatta - Festive
highlights: Wide flared sharara pants with a short embroidered kurta
Gota patti work in gold along the hem and cuffs
Georgette moves well and photographs with volume
Dupatta included with a matching gota border
description: A peacock blue georgette sharara set with wide flared pants, a short embroidered kurta and a matching dupatta. Gold gota patti work runs along the hems, and the volume in the pants photographs well at mehendi and sangeet functions.

name: Plum Block Print Kurti
title: Mitti and Co. Women's Plum Hand Block Print Cotton Kurti - Handcrafted Daywear
highlights: Traditional hand block printing using natural dyes
Each piece varies slightly, as hand printing does
Boat neck with a straight cut that skims rather than clings
Colours soften attractively over the first few washes
description: A plum cotton kurti hand block printed in small ivory motifs using natural dyes. Because each piece is printed by hand the motifs vary slightly, and the naturally dyed colours soften over the first few washes rather than fading flat.
care: Hand wash separately, dry in shade

name: Wine Velvet Indo Western Gown
title: Zari Lane Women's Wine Velvet Indo Western Gown with Cape Sleeves - Reception and Cocktail
highlights: Floor length velvet gown with attached cape sleeves
Embellished belt detail defining the waist
Concealed back zip with a fully lined interior
Winter weight, best for air conditioned or cool venues
description: A wine velvet floor length gown with attached cape sleeves and an embellished waist belt. It reads as Indo-western rather than traditional, and the velvet weight suits winter receptions or cool indoor venues rather than summer evenings.

name: Gold Banarasi Dupatta
title: Anaya Ethnics Women's Antique Gold Banarasi Silk Dupatta with Zari Weave - Ethnic Accessory
highlights: Woven Banarasi silk with all-over zari butis
2.5 metres, long enough to drape over both shoulders
Lifts a plain kurta set into festive dress
Tasselled edges finished by hand
description: An antique gold Banarasi silk dupatta woven with all-over zari butis and finished with hand-knotted tassels. At 2.5 metres it drapes over both shoulders, and it is the cheapest way to lift a plain kurta set into proper festive dress.

name: Black Cotton Palazzo
title: Rangrez Women's Black Cotton Wide Leg Palazzo Pants with Elasticated Waist - Everyday Bottom
highlights: Wide leg cotton palazzo with a fully elasticated waist
Side pockets deep enough for a phone
Black pairs with almost every kurti in the catalogue
Ankle length on an average height of 5 foot 4
description: Black wide leg cotton palazzo pants with a fully elasticated waist and deep side pockets. Plain and hardworking rather than decorative, they pair with almost every kurti in the catalogue and are the default bottom for everyday ethnic wear.

name: Teal Silk Kurta Set for Women
title: Vastra Studio Women's Teal Art Silk Kurta with Churidar and Dupatta - Festive Three Piece Set
highlights: Three piece set with churidar and matching dupatta
Embroidered yoke with a keyhole neck tie
Art silk holds a formal shape without silk's price
Suitable for evening pujas and family functions
description: A teal art silk three piece set with an embroidered yoke, keyhole neckline, matching churidar and dupatta. Art silk gives the formal shape and sheen of silk at a fraction of the cost, which makes it practical for frequently worn festive occasions.

name: Bottle Green Khadi Cotton Kurti
title: Mitti and Co. Women's Bottle Green Khadi Cotton Kurti with Wooden Buttons - Sustainable Daywear
highlights: Handspun khadi cotton woven on a village loom
Shirt collar with coconut shell buttons
Roll-tab sleeves for warmer afternoons
Khadi keeps you cool in summer and warm in winter
description: A bottle green khadi cotton kurti with a shirt collar, coconut shell buttons and roll-tab sleeves. Handspun khadi breathes in summer and insulates in winter, and the fabric develops a softer hand the longer it is worn.
